protocols.fixed0_to_fixed3: physical initial view fixed to 0, 1, 2, or 3
protocols.random_start: one deterministic uniform valid start per episode
protocols.first_transition: state of one observed view predicts second
protocols.second_transition: mean state of first two observed views predicts third
protocols.third_prediction: state of first three observed views predicts/logs fourth only
protocols.final_classification: mean logits of exactly first three observed views; fourth excluded
